about: Every tuning default the app applies to someone who has not chosen, with the committed benchmark that shows it wins against current behaviour (scripts/tuning_gate.py). Explicit opt-ins change no default and are listed with their source instead. tests/test_tuning_gate.py fails when the app produces a default that is not listed here, or a listed default no longer wins on its evidence.

defaults.what: A never-picked GPT-6.1 Sol model on a ChatGPT subscription starts new chats at High effort. Remembered picks (including Auto) still win; children, the assistant home and the provider's own default are unchanged.

opt_in.what: Local model preset the owner picks per model in Settings: temperature 0.6, top P 0.95, top K 20, min P 0, thinking on.
Local model preset the owner picks per model in Settings: temperature 0.7, top P 0.8, top K 20, min P 0, thinking off.
